description: This file contains helper functions for comparing git log graph outputs, primarily used in testing scenarios to sanitize, normalize, and compare generated log graphs.

methods.name: sanitize_log_output
methods.description: Sanitizes git log output by removing variable content such as commit hashes, index values, and merge descriptions, to facilitate consistent comparisons.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Runs git log with --graph, sanitizes the output, and compares it against an expected sanitized output to verify correctness.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_short_graph
methods.description: Runs a short-format git log with --graph, sanitizes the output, and compares it with expected output for testing.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Produces a colored git log graph, decodes the colors, and compares the sanitized output with expected results to test colored graph rendering.
